# Transcend 1TB MTE245S M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4x4 SSD, with Graphene Heatsink, Single Sided, 3D TLC, NVMe Internal Gaming SSD, Up to 5,300/4,000 MB/s - TS1TMTE245S
Brand: Transcend
Category: Data Storage > Internal Solid State Drives

## Features
High-Speed Data Transfer Utilizes a PCI Express 4.0 x4 (NVMe) interface, achieving sequential read speeds up to 5,300 MB/s and write speeds up to 4,600 MB/s.; Advanced Thermal Management Incorporates an ultra-thin graphene heat sink to effectively dissipate heat and maintain optimal operating temperatures.; Enhanced Data Integrity Features Low-Density Parity-Check (LDPC) code and a robust Error Correction Code (ECC) algorithm to ensure data accuracy and reliability.; High Endurance and Reliability Offers endurance metrics with total write capacities ranging from 300 TBW to 2,400 TBW, and a Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) rating of 2 million hours.; Capacious Storage Options Available in capacities ranging from 500 GB to 4 TB, accommodating various storage requirements.

## Specifications
Color: Black; Enclosure Material: 3D NAND flash; Cache Memory Installed Size: 1; Additional Features: Advanced Garbage Collection, Backward Compatible, LDPC Coding, S.M.A.R.T., TRIM Support; Digital Storage Capacity: 1 TB

## Pricing & Reviews
Rated 4.3 from 671 reviews.
Top review: This 4TB SSD comes with a thick heat shield and it's perfect for a board with no built in shield. It is faster than the previous generation.
